name: SupabaseStudio
description: Supabase Studio is the browser dashboard for managing a self-hosted Supabase project, including database tables, SQL, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, logs, project settings, and API credentials.

paths.name: Snippets
paths.description: Persistent SQL snippets folder used by Studio.

paths.name: Edge Functions
paths.description: Folder where Studio manages Edge Functions source files.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Supabase Studio web interface port. Container port: 3000. The official full stack normally exposes Studio through Kong on port 8000.

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: Interface Studio listens on inside the container.

variables.name: Postgres Meta URL
variables.description: Internal URL for the Supabase postgres-meta service.

variables.name: Supabase Internal URL
variables.description: Internal URL for the Supabase API gateway service.

variables.name: Supabase Public URL
variables.description: Public URL clients use to reach the Supabase API gateway, for example http://UNRAID-IP:8000 or https://supabase.example.com.

variables.name: Postgres Host
variables.description: Hostname for the Supabase Postgres service as seen from Studio.

variables.name: Postgres Port
variables.description: Supabase Postgres or Supavisor session port.

variables.name: Postgres Database
variables.description: Supabase Postgres database name.

variables.name: Postgres Password
variables.description: Database password generated for the Supabase stack.

variables.name: PG Meta Crypto Key
variables.description: Studio postgres-meta encryption key. Generate a unique value before production use.

variables.name: REST Schemas
variables.description: Comma-separated Postgres schemas exposed through PostgREST.

variables.name: REST Max Rows
variables.description: Maximum rows returned by REST API requests.

variables.name: REST Search Path
variables.description: Extra schemas added to the PostgREST search path.

variables.name: Default Organization
variables.description: Default organization name shown in Studio.

variables.name: Default Project
variables.description: Default project name shown in Studio.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: JWT secret generated for the Supabase stack.

variables.name: Anon Key
variables.description: Legacy anon API key generated by the Supabase key script.

variables.name: Service Role Key
variables.description: Legacy service role API key. Never expose this key to client-side code.

variables.name: Publishable Key
variables.description: Opaque publishable API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Opaque secret API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups. Never expose this key to client-side code.

variables.name: Logflare URL
variables.description: Internal URL for the Supabase analytics service.

variables.name: Logflare API Key
variables.description: Deprecated compatibility variable. Set to the same value as Logflare Public Token when the Studio image expects it.

variables.name: Logflare Public Token
variables.description: Logflare public access token generated for the Supabase stack.

variables.name: Logflare Private Token
variables.description: Logflare private access token generated for the Supabase stack.

variables.name: Enable Logs
variables.description: Enable the Studio logs interface. Use true or false.

variables.name: Analytics Backend
variables.description: Analytics backend provider used by Studio. The official Docker stack defaults to postgres.

variables.name: Snippets Folder
variables.description: Path inside the container where Studio manages SQL snippets.

variables.name: Edge Functions Folder
variables.description: Path inside the container where Studio manages Edge Functions.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Optional OpenAI API key used by the Supabase Studio AI assistant.
